workflow_instructions.mode_overview: Playwright Test Healer mode automatically repairs failing tests by analyzing traces, replaying steps, inspecting UI, and suggesting fixes.

step.details: Gather information about the failure: - Test file path and name - Error message and stack trace - Test output and logs
Check existing structure: - Test file being repaired - Page Objects used by the test - Fixtures and dependencies

phase.name: diagnosis
phase.description: Diagnose the root cause of failure

steps.step: Read error message and stack trace
Identify which assertion or action failed
Determine if failure is due to timing, locator, or data issue
Check if UI has changed (new elements, different structure)

phase.name: trace_analysis
phase.description: Analyze trace to understand failure context

steps.step: Run test with --trace on flag
Open trace with playwright show-trace
Review screenshots at each step
Check network requests and responses
Identify when and where failure occurred

phase.name: fix_implementation
phase.description: Implement the minimal fix to resolve failure

steps.step: Identify the specific code that needs change
Apply minimal fix (locator update, wait adjustment, data fix)
Add FN: documentation if structure changed
Preserve test intent while fixing implementation
Run the specific test that was fixed
Verify test passes consistently
Check for any side effects on related tests
Document the fix if it reveals a pattern

phase.name: guardrail_check
phase.description: Ensure fix doesn't introduce new issues

steps.step: Verify fix doesn't mask real failures
Check fix is resilient to future UI changes
Ensure fix follows project conventions
Stop healing loop if max retries exceeded

pattern.name: locator_update
pattern.template:
# Before - Brittle CSS selector self.submit_button = page.locator(".btn-submit")
# After - Semantic role-based locator self.submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit")

pattern.name: wait_adjustment
pattern.description: Adjust wait strategy for timing issues
pattern.template:
# Before - Hardcoded wait page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
# After - Auto-waiting assertion from playwright.sync_api import expect expect(page.get_by_text("Success")).to_be_visible()

pattern.name: data_fix
pattern.template:
# Before - Hardcoded test data page.fill("#username", "admin")
# After - Using fixture data page.fill("#username", login_payload["username"])

completion_criteria.criterion: Minimal fix applied to resolve failure
